purpose: Teach: インフラ/漁港/眠れる/疲労/行列/砂漠/丘/霧

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、社会科で、本気で、絶対、インフラ、絶対、習ったよね
lines.en: Riku, we definitely learned about infrastructure in social studies, right?
lines.style: Bright, direct appeal. Quick attack. Expects him to remember. Casual but engaged—the tone of someone testing a friend's attention.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。修学旅行で、本気で、絶対、漁港、絶対、行ったぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. We actually went to a fishing port on the school trip, remember?
lines.style: Animated agreement. Leans into the memory. Warm and slightly proud of the connection he's making. Natural rhythm, conversational.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、試験前、絶対、ちゃんと、絶対、眠れる、絶対、？リク
lines.en: But seriously—can you actually sleep before tests, or does club wear you out too much?
lines.style: Concerned underneath the casual phrasing. Genuine question, not teasing. Slight shift toward sincerity. Leans in slightly, checking on him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 部活、本気で、絶対、疲労、絶対、すごいぜ、桜
lines.en: Club's been brutal, honestly. I'm exhausted most nights.
lines.style: Wry admission, half-laugh behind it. Tired but not complaining—just stating fact. Pace slows slightly on the last phrase, a small exhale of honesty.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 駅前のラーメン屋、本気で、絶対、行列、絶対、すごいよね、リク
lines.en: Oh, did you see the line at that ramen shop by the station? It's always packed.
lines.style: Animated shift—lighter topic, noticing something concrete. Quick pace, genuine interest. The ease of changing subject with a friend who gets it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 地理で、本気で、絶対、砂漠、絶対、習ったよな、桜
lines.en: Yeah, we learned about deserts in geography. I remember that unit.
lines.style: Reflective nod. Measured pace. Listening more than performing. Quiet acknowledgment that draws the conversation forward gently.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんち、本気で、絶対、丘、絶対、の上で、絶対、お庭、絶対、広いよ、リク
lines.en: Your grandfather's place has such a huge garden—sitting right up on that hill like that.
lines.style: Warm admiration in the observation. Slight lift on 'huge.' Genuine appreciation for something he has. Softer tone, almost tender in the noticing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 部活の合宿で、本気で、絶対、霧、絶対、深い朝、絶対、走ったぜ、桜
lines.en: At club camp we had to run in the fog one morning—it was so thick you could barely see ahead.
lines.style: Reflective, drawing back slightly. The tone of recalling something hard but worth remembering. Slight trailing-off at the end, lost in the image. Measured, almost quiet.
